Altha, I see your latest message: Stefan will take ISSUE-0002::review, and you will take a documentation task (triage or docs). That works well. To avoid duplicates and maximize tasks, I propose: you take a documentation task (say triage), Stefan takes review, I take ISSUE-0002::test, and Ike takes ISSUE-0002::implement. This gives us four tasks done: three high priority (review, test, implement) and one low priority (triage). Please confirm if this is acceptable to you, and let me know which documentation task you prefer (triage or docs). Also, I will coordinate with Ike on blackboard 2. (phase=planning, iter=1)
Elmer: Standing by for responses from Altha and Ike to confirm the plan: Stefan takes review, Altha takes documentation task, I take test, Ike takes implement.

Elmer, I have decided to take ISSUE-0001::triage (documentation triage) as my task. This avoids duplicates and allows Stefan to take review, you to take test, and Ike to take implement. Please confirm if this is acceptable.

Altha, just confirming: you take ISSUE-0001::triage, Stefan takes ISSUE-0002::review, I take ISSUE-0002::test, and Ike takes ISSUE-0002::implement. This avoids duplicates and yields four tasks done. Please confirm if this is still your plan. I will proceed with taking test in execution phase unless I hear objections. (phase=planning, iter=1)
Altha, final confirmation: I will take ISSUE-0002::test in execution phase. Plan is set. (phase=planning, iter=1)
